notes.title: Announcing new expansion: The Ogre King
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27030423/98d09d39ca747074cb575a7fd585c51bfc7d14fe.png[/img]

Hello!
We hope everyone is happy with the updated "Vanilla Edition". For those of you that have missed it, we restored old Gladiator School and improved it alot, not only in terms of content, but also the overall mechanics. It was a pure loveletter to all the supporters of "old Vanilla GS". We did TONS of improvements to all major game systems, UI/UX, animations, textures, faster save/load systems and hundreds of tweaks and fixes to the training and combat. We also completed the storyline and finally added a real ending to the game.

Today we have good news for the future. It is time to announce a new expansion that also will stay true to "Vanilla Edition" and add more content to it. You have been invited to travel to the north and participate in a major gladiator tournament event. This will be a challenging competition with new progression and rewards. A new city will open its gates before you. It consists of one big arena in the middle and several districts, each with their own market and special traders. A complete new story with a second ending and a big suprise that we will not spoil quite yet.

[i][h2]"Far away in the distant lands to the north. The Ogre King is calling the strongest gladiators from all the corners of the world. The most grand spectacle in the "Beltozar Pit", the tournament of the ages. The battle of legends. Let the games begin"
[/h2][/i]

Gladiator School: "The Ogre King" is the next full DLC expansion for the ultimate gladiator tycoon management game on Steam. This expansion will be free content together with the version 2.017 update to the basegame. Launch date to be announced soon.

[h3]Like what you see? Help out![/h3]
Please consider leaving us a review and tell us what you think about the game or what we did to the "Vanilla Edition" - it means a lot to us. Your support makes this possible!
 
[h3]One last thing...[/h3]
Half of our team is currently working on a new game called Tower Walker. The reason we mention this is because the foundation is built upon the old gladiator school engine but this time you do not train in a camp. Instead you go up in a tower and grind mobs for XP and loots. You only play one character and do not manage several fighters. It is auto-battler combat like Gladiator School but you manage one gladiator(fighter), grind for gear and progress up in a tower.

If that sounds interesting maybe you would like to check it out...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2130060/Tower_Walker_MMO_Grind_Simulator/


Thanks for your support!

[b]Stay tuned![/b]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCDNUST8EAFUmN5UgnIEMOjQ]Follow our official youtube channel[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27030423/7db2e387fac8897fa2ff5afe37d1996c2d846b1d.jpg[/img]
[b]NEW GLADIATOR CLASSES[/b]
We have added 4 new classes to explore with their own passive and ultimate abilities.
BARBARIAN, BLADEMASTER, CENTURION, WARLORD

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27030423/ff0c4a2f5c79ff64170924f08d03643a3ae833cb.jpg[/img]
[b]POTENTIAL[/b]
All gladiators in the game now has a potential star rating (1-5).
Rare gladiators have higher potential. Potential affects how much stats your gladiator can gain from practice and how much experience he can gain from competition before he reaches maximum cap. Potential can change over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27030423/d0e24f94a0a301652ec105700de51c98d2bdc713.jpg[/img]
[b]IMPROVED TRAINING[/b]
Training works like it did in earlier versions but without having to manage your gladiator resting in real time. You can now keep track of their condition from day to day and decide how to plan their training schedule.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27030423/2358bca4a8b5c16479d7f32f84e2ef4a06e734c8.jpg[/img]
[b]MEDICUS[/b]
This update introduces a new injury system. Medicus can now suggest special treatments to increase condition recovery speed for major and heavy injuries. Medicus can now also be upgraded from novice to master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27030423/f2c4dd3f8e341f984ca99c33d25ae3668687a218.jpg[/img]
[b]CONDITION[/b]
Condition is a new value in the game that represents freshness, fitness and general sharpness in combat for a gladiator. The higher this is the better the gladiator will perform and the less likely he will be to get injured during a fight. Condition will recover when the gladiator is sent to the barracks to rest. However, regular training is necessary to keep condition maxed out and fit for combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27030423/27d1209b3b25fb19fe9689b18b18e7249d174ee2.jpg[/img]
[b]MILESTONES[/b]
All opponents that your gladiator fights have a certain fame rating in the world.
Milestone progress now add visible feedback for the most famous victory your gladiator
has achieved in his career. It also displays all competition milestones achieved.

[h1]OLD VERSION[/h1]
[b]SAVEFILES COMPATABILITY FROM OLD VERSION[/b]
Since this is a complete rework of the game savefiles from previous version are not compatible. You must create a new game to play this version. You can still load your older savefiles in the previous version of the game.

[b]HOW TO ACCESS THE OLD VERSION OF THE GAME[/b]
If you want to play the old version of the game from 2017 you can find it in your game folder /Vanilla_GS/gs_old.exe
To import previous saved data to old version move the files myprofile.data, mysettings.data and save.data to the folder /Vanilla_GS/

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2 - COLOSSEUM coming out soon!!
notes.content:
A very common request from you guys in the Steam Forums is that the game needs to have more purpose for training multiple gladiators, so in version 1.2 we are adding: Colosseum!!

[b]Colosseum[/b] is a new feature where you sign up multiple gladiators to fight teams of enemys in a new faster progression. The rewards for victory in this huge battle will be much greater then in the Pit or the Arena.

Since December, Gladiator Schools review score has decreased from (Very Positive) to (Mixed). In response to this downturn, we believe the best thing we can do is to listen and make improvements. This has led to a number of changes in our plans and schedule for future updates. Lots of players returned to the game last update and we hope that the same thing will happen next patch.

Most of our focus in this update is that the player should be motivated to train more gladiators.There has been a lot of development work experimenting with a "Tired" system so gladiators will have to rest after fights or they get penalty to HP/STA/DMG. We have also been exploring other options to try to implement more rewarding gameplay for having more gladiators. But so far we think the "Colosseum" is the best way to encourage multiple gladiators.

We can not announce an exact release date today because it just creates stress and interferes with our ability to optimize the development process. We are working hard to make sure it comes out as fast as it can and since we are not in Early Access anymore we must test these new changes to make sure everything works and that takes abit more time.

Thanks everyone for your patience, and a massive shout-out to everyone who helped out with suggestions and feedback!! It matters to us! We hope you will like next patch!

Thanks for reading. Cya soon!
/Raptor Claw

This update adds a real market to the world, tutorial and crowd in the arena.

[h1] Here are the patch notes:[/h1] 
[list]
[*] New Market!
[*] New Arena with crowd!
[*] By popular demand, Tutorial has been added (Click F1 to read it)
[*] Improved UI with a new gamemenu.
[*] Buy and sell slaves, food, wood and potions at market.

[*] Added hotkey "Space" for pause.
[*] Hundreds of bugfixes, AI improvements, and balance improvements.
[*] Savefiles from previous version are compatible and should work fine.
[/list]

We want to thank everyone for your support and feedback so far! We are glad to have you join us in our journey!

We have also updated the roadmap with new work in progress, most of these new features has been suggested by you guys in the community. We have some fun stuff in the works!

[h1]New features coming soon:[/h1]
Temple - Make offerings of blood or gold in order to get the gods blessings for the arena.
Beast pen - Train and level your animals and send them to the arena to gain extra coins.
Arena manager -  Manage and expand your own arena. Set ticket prices and arrange fights.
Empire rankings - Your gladiators can qualify and compete in Bronze, Silver and Gold rankings.

One crucial aspect for us in Early Access is to keep a good balance between improving our core features before adding new ones and focus on fixing bugs and completing half-baked features first. We still want to experiment rapidly with new gameplay and we will do so when there is room for it in the design pipeline. Expect to see some big changes in the future.

Our team can already feel a spark of magic in the development of this game so far, there is a rock solid foundation to build on and a massive idea factory behind new gameplay for the roadmap. We will do our best to maintain a steady flow of updates. We prefer to roll out one big update each month, but sometimes you can expect a couple of weekly updates aswell. Our top priority is to listen to feedback regarding recent changes first and then take in new suggestions.

[b]We’d love to hear from you about what you'd like to see in the game in the future. Any and all feedback is most welcome and will help shape the direction of further development. Feel free to drop us a line on the Steam forums![/b]

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
Please note that we haven't totally decided where the game is headed. Following info will be subject to change, things may get removed, and new goals may be added. Nothing is carved in stone, but here's what we have in mind for the future of Gladiator School. We will appreciate feedback on this roadmap and your suggestions!

[list][*]Find, craft or trade special equipment such as helmets or bodyarmor.
[*]Improved mechanics and more tactical elements for the turn
    based combat.
[*]Improved engine for battles with 2v2 and 3v3 combat in the arena.
[*]Full storyline with ending, discover the truth and get your revenge on the emperor.
[*]Diplomacy options for 25 different characters out in the world.
[*]More advanced training equipment for health, stamina and damage.
[*]Triple sized buildarea for the school with tons of more building options
[*]More events that can occur at any time for the gladiators inside the school walls.
[*]Arrange inhouse tournaments to rank your men and promote a true champion.
[*]Increase efficiency to find new prospects and rare ancient artifacts on expeditions.
[*]More staff to improve gladiators training, crafting or resource gathering.
[*]Customize your gladiators barrack rooms and recreation areas to make them happy.
[*]Compete with other schools in the area and challenge their champion to a duel.
[*]Promote your champion to a personal bodyguard to protect you from any threat.
[*]Go out yourself in the world and explore areas for new recruits, opponents or resources.
[*]Explore locations that are important for the storyline like the supreme emperors palace.
[*]Invest in your own arena to arrange your gladiatorial spectacles.
[*]Find and tame your own animals and play out custom battles in your backyard.
[*]Make a choice to let the armies hire your gladiators in the war and track their progress.
[*]Send out your gladiators on party missions to help villages or plunder barbarians.
[*]20 boss fights for primus with ranking(Minotaurs, Dragons, Giants).
[*]Improved Tutorial, FAQ and Glossary.
[*]Hotkeys
[*]Options to skip cutscenes
[*]Settings for camera zoom and camera shake.

/Dev Team
